name: Input Buffer
description: Widens 1-tick frame-perfect jump timings into a 2-8 tick window by buffering early clicks.

enabled.name: Enable Input Buffer
enabled.description: Turns the buffering on or off.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer Window (ticks)
buffer-ticks.description: How many physics ticks a click stays 'armed'. 1 = vanilla (frame-perfect). 2-4 turns a 1-tick timing into a 2-4 tick window. One tick is about 4.17ms at 240 TPS.

buffer-player2.name: Buffer Player 2
buffer-player2.description: Also buffer clicks for the second player in dual mode.

skip-held-modes.name: Skip Ship and Wave
skip-held-modes.description: Ship and wave are hold-based, so buffering does nothing useful there. Leave this on to avoid extra release/press toggling.
